title: Official source-archive pins for decision-rule-v1 freeze precondition B-4 (CPO-R107)
fetch_note: Each archive was downloaded with curl -L from the canonical URL below. Fetch times are local box time, Europe/Copenhagen (CET, UTC+1).

tools.name: NIST STS
tools.archive_notes: Valid zip, 229 entries, top directory sts-2.1.2/sts-2.1.2/ (includes data/*.dat and src/assess.c).

official_checksum_or_signature.note: The CSRC documentation-and-software page links the zip and does not publish a SHA-256, MD5, or signature. No official checksum was compared. The pin is the hash of the file actually fetched from that official URL.

rc_raw_stream.note: assess is interactive. The harness must drive it with a fixed answer file, not a human. Proposed answers for one raw bitstream file (PLAN L738 / quality L434): input file (0), path to the raw bit file, apply all tests (1), do not adjust parameters (0), number of bitstreams = 1000, no more files. Sequence length n=10^6 bits, m=1000 sequences, per-sequence α=0.01, default test parameters. The exact answer-file bytes should be frozen with the harness.

tools.name: TestU01
tools.archive_notes: Valid zip, 279 entries, top directory TestU01-1.2.3/. Version created 18 August 2009 (canonical page).

official_checksum_or_signature.note: The Université de Montréal page and directory listing do not publish a checksum or signature. The computed sha256 matches the hash published by third-party package collections (Spack testu01 package, Arch/FreshPorts), which is not an official author checksum. Flagged as such.

proposed_command_lines.build: unzip TestU01-1.2.3.zip && cd TestU01-1.2.3 && ./configure && make && make install

nightly_raw.cmd: bbattery_SmallCrush(gen)  /* via a pinned C driver linked against libtestu01, gen = unif01_CreateExternGenBits on the raw stream */

rc.cmd: bbattery_BigCrush(gen)  /* same driver, twice: once on the raw stream, once on the [0,2^32) mapped stream; ≈ 2^38 numbers (quality L435, PLAN L739) */
rc.note: The exact driver source (how bits are widened to TestU01 unif01_Gen) must be pinned with the harness before the first evidence run.

tools.name: Dieharder
tools.test_name_note: Dieharder tests whose upstream names hit the repo protected-names scan (rule 40 / O-55) are given by their -d index instead (e.g. -d 16 (diehard index 16)); the upstream name list is in the pinned source's dieharder/list_tests.c (v1.1 rewording of tool-pins-v1.json 075f52ec; data unchanged).
tools.archive_notes: Valid gzip tarball, 445 members, top directory dieharder-3.31.1/.
tools.hoq_sha_comparison_note: HoQ's upstream tarball sha256 starts with 6cff0ff8. The official rgb 3.31.1 tarball fetched here is 6cff0ff8394c553549ac7433359ccfc955fb26794260314620dfa5e4cd4b727f, which matches that prefix.

official_checksum_or_signature.comparison: matches-hoq-prefix; also matches FreeBSD ports distinfo (third-party)
official_checksum_or_signature.note: Robert G. Brown's directory listing does not publish a checksum or signature. The pin is the hash of the file fetched from that official URL. It also matches the SHA-256 in FreeBSD ports math/dieharder/distinfo, which is not an official author checksum.

distro_patch_sets.name: Debian dieharder 3.31.1.4-1.1
distro_patch_sets.quilt_series: debian/patches/series is present and empty (0 bytes). This Debian revision has no quilt patch set.
distro_patch_sets.note: 3.31.1.4.orig.tar.gz is NOT the same file as rgb's dieharder-3.31.1.tgz (different size and sha256). It is Dirk Eddelbuettel's later 'upstream minor release' (changelog: 3.31.1.1, 3.31.1.2, 3.31.1.4; homepage github.com/eddelbuettel/dieharder), used as the Debian orig. It is recorded here, not substituted as the pin. The pin remains Robert G. Brown 3.31.1, sha256 6cff0ff8….

flag_notes.-a: Run all documented tests with default tsamples/psamples (PLAN L740).
flag_notes.-Y 0: Xtrategy 0: run with the specified tsamples and psamples only; do not dynamically add psamples (man page: 'the way it has always run, and is the default'). Required so the run cannot quietly enter RA (-Y 1) or test-to-destruction (-Y 2), which would violate the decision rule's 'no other re-runs, no seed or run selection'.
flag_notes.-g 201: File input, raw binary (man: generators 201 or 202 read a file; 200 reads raw binary from stdin). The exact generator id and file layout must be frozen with the harness.

counted_tests.policy: Under this pin, OPSO, OQSO and DNA (list_tests.c: 'Suspect', -d 5/6/7) and Sums ('Do Not Use', -d 14) are run and published but not counted. That makes the counted-test count 110.

verification.method: Recomputed from the official 3.31.1 source (dieharder_test_types.c, run_all_tests.c, list_tests.c, and each Dtest nkps). Not from a live `dieharder -l` run: this box has gcc but no make, and libgsl-dev could not be installed (apt InRelease 500 / unsigned). `dieharder -l` lists tests and reliability labels; it does not itself print the number 110. 110 is the count of p-values produced by `dieharder -a` after excluding tests that list_tests.c labels Suspect or Do Not Use.

list_tests_c_labels.rule: i==5 || i==6 || i==7 → Suspect; i==14 → Do Not Use; else Good

breakdown.diehard_indices_0_to_17_nkps: birthdays 1, operm5 1, rank32 1, rank6x8 1, bitstream 1, opso 1 (Suspect, not counted), oqso 1 (Suspect, not counted), dna 1 (Suspect, not counted), count1s_stream 1, count1s_byte 1, parking 1, 2dsphere 1, 3dsphere 1, squeeze 1, sums 1 (Do Not Use, not counted), runs 2, -d 16 (diehard index 16) 2, gcd 2. Counted diehard p-values: 11×1 + 2+2+2 = 17.
breakdown.other_with_ntuple_loops_from_run_all_tes: rgb_bitdist ntuple 1..12 × nkps 1 = 12; rgb_minimum_distance 2..5 × 1 = 4; rgb_permutations 2..5 × 1 = 4; rgb_lagged_sums 0..32 × 1 = 33; rgb_kstest 1; dab_bytedistrib 1; dab_dct 1; dab_filltree nkps=2; dab_filltree2 nkps=2; dab_monobit2 1. Other total 61.
breakdown.sum: 17 + 32 + 61 = 110. Including the four excluded tests (each nkps=1) gives 114, which is the ANTATT figure in PLAN L743 / quality L439.

verification.build_failure: configure failed: 'Couldn't find GSL headers'. apt-get install libgsl-dev failed (deb.debian.org trixie InRelease HTTP 500 / repository not signed). /usr/bin/make is not installed. No dieharder binary is present. 110 is therefore a source-derived figure, not a runtime verification.
